hook: The greatest boxer you've never heard of? He was tiny, but unbeatable.
story: His name was Rocky Marciano, the son of an Italian shoemaker in Massachusetts. He dug ditches, hauled ice, and only started boxing seriously at 23. At five foot ten, he was one of the smallest heavyweights ever - giving away height and reach in almost every fight. In 1952, fighting for the world title, he was knocked down in the first round and losing on points. Then, in the thirteenth, he threw one overhand right and knocked the champion out cold.
number: He defended that title six times, then walked away. Final record: 49 fights, 49 wins, 43 by knockout. Zero losses.
